title: Logo
summary: Contract for the Logo component: brand.variant arrangements, generated marks, real logo sources, per-nav placement behavior, clear space, minimum sizes and size scale.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity: reads as component reference/guide, but defines config fields, enum values, per-nav placement table, and hard rules (min mark 20px, lockup 96px, stacked never in nav bar, never redraw a real company's mark). Resolved toward SPEC per ADR > SPEC > PRD > DOC rule. No path heuristic, no frontmatter. Filename deviates from {slug}-{sha256[:8]} convention: classifier had no shell to compute SHA-256 of the source path; no sibling named logo.md expected.
